rows.displayName: A projective fourfold with large fundamental group and non-Stein universal cover

claim.ja: 滑らかな連結射影複素四次元多様体Xに単純アーベル曲面Aを埋め込み、Xの基本群はlarge、π₁(A)の像はℤ。普遍被覆は正次元コンパクト解析部分多様体を含まず非Stein。
claim.en: A smooth connected projective complex fourfold X contains a simple abelian surface A, with large fundamental group and image π₁(A) ≅ ℤ. Its universal cover has no positive-dimensional compact analytic subvariety and is not Stein.

role.ja: 局所被覆と双曲的経路判定で無限巡回像を保ち、射影的実現を経てlargeな四次元多様体へ。閉じた持上げ曲面のH₃をStein性の障害にする。
role.en: Local covers and hyperbolic path tests preserve a cyclic image through projective realization; a final complete intersection gives largeness. The lifted closed surface has nonzero H₃, obstructing Steinness.

rows.displayName: A surface counterexample to Shafarevich holomorphic convexity

claim.ja: 滑らかな連結射影複素曲面X内に、有理成分からなる連結nodal曲線Z₀を構成し、π₁(Z₀)の像を無限にする。普遍被覆内の一点の正則包が非コンパクト。
claim.en: A smooth connected projective complex surface X contains a connected nodal curve Z₀ with rational components and infinite fundamental-group image. A singleton in the universal cover has noncompact holomorphic hull.

role.ja: 重み付き群表示で無限性を確保し、境界の局所群を有限商で検出して射影的コンパクト化後も維持する。有理曲線の無限連鎖を正則凸性の障害にする。
role.en: A weighted group presentation ensures infinitude, while finite detection of local boundary groups preserves it through projective compactification. An infinite chain of rational curves obstructs holomorphic convexity.
